exposure: systematic oxidative stress markers (serum malondialdehyde, superoxide dismutase, glutathione peroxidase levels on the day of hCG trigger)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 50 patients with PCOS and 50 patients without PCOS, all aged less than 35 years, with a BMI less than 28 kg/m2, undergoing IVF/ICSI treatment between February 2017 and January 2018.
finding: Moderate systemic oxidative stress on the hCG trigger day had no detrimental effects on live birth rate in young and non-obese patients with PCOS after IVF/ICSI treatment.
